eval.protocol: fixed dev-clean subset, seed, greedy CTC, normalized text

manifest.description: FP32 master weights for every parameter (BitLinear masters, biases, LayerNorms, convolutions, feature projection, CTC head). Structurally identical to the original FP32 checkpoint; binary weights exist only at forward time.
manifest.expected_reconstruction: Wav2Vec2ConformerForCTC.from_pretrained(dir) then replace_linears(...) with the same layer selection; forward() binarizes from these masters.
